metadata.genoa:note: Same-origin basemap style for the Live Map. Edit visually in maputnik (point it at {origin}/styles/genoa.json). Data layers (geo.stations, future contours/coverage) are added on top in code from the map LAYERS registry, so this file owns only the BASEMAP. To make the basemap blocker-proof, replace the 'carto-dark' raster source with a self-hosted vector source: { "type": "vector", "url": "pmtiles://https://genoaiq.com/basemap" } (served by the app's /basemap proxy from Spaces) and style its layers here.
